statement: A bubble-point solve announces as accepted a pair-span excursion and Psat extrapolations made at its initial guess (x-weighted Tb, BubblePoint.cpp:104-108) while the published answer lies inside every span; reproducer: ethanol+ethyleneGlycol+water NRTL, propertyScan1D T_bubble at 101300 Pa, x (0.078 0.169 0.753): T_bubble 365.339 K, [pair-span] ethanol-water 'used at T = 387.9 K'.

Three catalogue UNIQUAC records (aceticAcid-methylAcetate, methanol-methylAcetate, methylAcetate-water; Popken 2000) declare no validity span, so no use of them at any T is ever announced; reproducer: methylAcetate+water UNIQUAC, activityCoefficients at 500 K: no announcement.
